items.title: Archive: October 2026 - GitHub Changelog
items.summary_zh: 这是 GitHub 2026 年 10 月的变更归档页，汇总了多项产品更新。与 AI 编码相关的可见条目包括：GitHub Copilot 本地沙箱正式可用、Copilot CLI 可发现本地模型、Copilot code review 增加 API 支持并调整默认 effort level，以及 Claude Haiku 5.5 接入 Copilot。
items.summary_en: This is GitHub’s October 2026 changelog archive aggregating product updates. AI-coding-relevant entries visible from the archive include GA for local sandboxing in GitHub Copilot, discovery of local models in Copilot CLI, API support plus a new default effort level for Copilot code review, and Claude Haiku 5.5 in Copilot.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 虽然不是深度技术文章，但这些条目指向几个重要方向：更安全的代理执行环境、本地/边缘模型接入开发工作流，以及将 AI 代码评审能力产品化并暴露为 API。这些都是平台团队在企业内落地 AI 编码时最关心的控制面。
items.why_it_matters_en: While not a deep technical post, these entries point to important directions: safer agent execution environments, local/edge model integration into developer workflows, and productized AI code review exposed through APIs. Those are central control-plane concerns for enterprise adoption of AI coding.
key_takeaways_zh: 高价值信号集中在执行隔离、本地模型接入、以及代码评审自动化 API 化三个方向。
由于页面只是归档摘要，没有实现细节、评测方法、权限模型或运维限制，暂时只能作为跟进入口。
key_takeaways_en: The highest-value signals cluster around execution isolation, local model integration, and API-enabled automated code review.

Because this is only an archive summary, it lacks implementation details, evaluation methodology, permission models, and operational constraints, so it should be treated only as a pointer for follow-up.

new_terms_zh: 本地模型发现（local model discovery）
themes_zh: AI 编码代理的安全执行边界
本地模型进入开发者工具链
代码评审能力从 UI 走向 API
themes_en: Secure execution boundaries for AI coding agents
Local models entering the developer toolchain
Code review capabilities moving from UI to API
implications_zh: 如果 Copilot 本地沙箱能力成熟，企业将更容易允许代理执行受限命令或在合规环境中操作代码。
本地模型发现意味着开发者工具可能逐步支持混合推理路由：云模型负责复杂任务，本地模型负责低延迟或敏感代码场景。
代码评审 API 化为平台团队把 AI 审查嵌入 PR 流程、策略引擎和内部质量门禁提供了基础。
implications_en: If Copilot local sandboxing is mature, enterprises may be more willing to permit constrained agent execution or code operations in compliance-sensitive environments.
Local model discovery suggests a future hybrid routing pattern in developer tools: cloud models for harder tasks and local models for low-latency or sensitive-code scenarios.
API-enabled code review creates a foundation for platform teams to embed AI review into PR workflows, policy engines, and internal quality gates.
what_to_ignore_zh: 忽略同一批候选中的重复 GitHub Changelog 总索引页，它只是归档导航，不增加新信息。
先不要过度解读 Claude Haiku 5.5 接入这类模型上架信息；没有上下文时通常只是供应侧扩展，而非工作流能力突破。
what_to_ignore_en: Ignore the duplicate GitHub Changelog index entry in the candidate set; it is just archive navigation and adds no new information.
Do not over-interpret the Claude Haiku 5.5 availability note; without context it is usually a supply-side catalog update rather than a workflow breakthrough.
